data.professional_title: Senior Business Analyst – Salesforce| Mortgage & Digital Lending
data.summary:
Senior Business Analyst with extensive experience delivering digital lending and mortgage platform transformations across retail banking ecosystems. Proven expertise analyzing and improving end-to-end lending journeys including application capture, credit assessment, underwriting, decisioning, loan origination, and servicing. Specialized in Salesforce-enabled lending ecosystems, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), and API-driven fintech integrations supporting broker, direct, and partner channels. Experienced working closely with credit policy teams, brokers, operations, product owners, and technology partners to design scalable, compliant, and customer-centric lending platforms. Strong capabilities in process modelling (BPMN), workflow automation, decisioning logic, requirements engineering, and UAT strategy, ensuring lending platforms deliver operational efficiency, improved broker experience, and regulatory compliance.
 •
DOMAIN and FUNCTIONAL EXPERTISE - End-to-end loan origination lifecycle: lead sourcing, application capture, credit assessment, underwriting, decisioning, loan booking, and servicing; Loan Origination Systems (LOS) workflow design and rule-based credit decisioning; Credit policy translation into platform logic, eligibility rules, and automated decisioning; Broker / DSA / fintech lead ingestion and application orchestration; Digital lending journeys including KYC, bureau checks, document verification, eSign, disbursement; Customer journey optimization across digital lending channels REQUIREMENTS and BUSINESS ANALYSIS - Business Requirements Document (BRD), Functional Specification Document (FSD), User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Data Dictionary, Process Flows (AS-IS / TO-BE), Gap Analysis, Impact Analysis, Stakeholder Workshops, Backlog Refinement, Definition of Done (DoD), UAT Strategy, Test Scenarios, Defect Triage, Traceability (RTM) TECHNICAL and DATA ACUMEN - API Integrations (REST), JSON, XML, SQL, Data Mapping & Transformation, Core Banking Integrations, Credit Bureau Integrations, KYC & Verification Systems, Swagger / Postman API Validation, Data Validation & Reconciliation, Error Handling & Integration Behavior, Event-Driven Integrations TOOLS and PLATFORMS - Power BI, Jira, Confluence, MS Excel (Pivot Tables, Lookups), Visio, BPMN, Figma, Draw.io, Postman, Swagger, SQL GOVERNANCE and DELIVERY - Agile / Scrum Delivery, UAT Planning & Execution, Release Readiness, Change Management, Risk & Dependency Management, Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination, Compliance Alignment, Audit Readiness, Production Go-Live & Post-Deployment Stabilization

Analyzed AS-IS loan origination processes and designed TO-BE lending workflows to improve decisioning speed, reduce manual intervention, and enhance customer experience. Translated credit policy and underwriting rules into system behavior, eligibility logic, and workflow decision nodes within LOS/LMS platforms. Defined functional requirements, process maps, user stories, and acceptance criteria for lending platform enhancements across multiple asset products. Designed API-driven workflows enabling lead ingestion, KYC verification, bureau checks, credit scoring, loan approval, and disbursement orchestration. Identified opportunities to automate manual credit assessment tasks and streamline data capture, improving operational efficiency across partner-led lending journeys. Collaborated with engineering and architecture teams to implement event-driven lending workflows and real-time credit decisioning integrations. Owned UAT planning and execution, validating platform behavior against real-world lending scenarios and ensuring alignment with credit policy and operational processes. Tested functional requirements and decisioning logic to confirm system outcomes matched expected lending policy and underwriting scenarios. Supported release cycles including defect triage, resolution prioritization, and post-implementation validation of lending platform improvements Led end-to-end Business Analysis for LOS & LMS modernization under a BaaS operating model for asset products including Credit Cards, Personal Loans, Gold Loans, and Auto Loans, enabling API-first native digital journeys across channels.
• • • •
Owned functional and API requirements for integration with Lending Service Providers (LSPs) and Technology Service Providers (TSPs), covering lead sourcing, credit decisioning, KYC, eSign, disbursement, and repayment orchestration. Acted as the BA owner for asset onboarding journeys, translating product and regulatory needs into API contracts (request/response, error handling, SLAs) for seamless integration between core lending systems, partner platforms, and fintech ecosystems. Collaborated with architecture and engineering teams to define event-driven and synchronous APIs enabling real-time credit decisioning, limit management, loan booking, and post-disbursement servicing across asset classes. Drove native digital journeys (bank-owned UX) to reduce dependency on partner UI, improving regulatory control, auditability, and customer experience consistency across lending products. Supported UAT and regulator-aligned validations, ensuring LOS/LMS releases met RBI audit expectations, partner certification requirements, and internal risk/compliance sign-offs. Enabled scalable BaaS lending capabilities by standardizing partner onboarding, API versioning, and reusable asset journey components, accelerating launch timelines for new lending products and partners. Drove stakeholder reviews and obtained formal sign-offs across business and technology teams. Planned and tracked development sprints and release schedules. Acted as a single point of coordination between business, product, technology, operations, and external vendors. Facilitated requirement discussions, solution design reviews, and implementation workshops.
